title: Korean shop staff surround you? Say THIS 😅 #learnkorean
caption:
구경만 할게요 (gu-gyeong-man hal-ge-yo) = I'm just looking 🛍️
Say it when shop staff keep handing you samples — they'll smile and let you browse.
…just don't say 예쁘다 ("so pretty") out loud 😂

Words in this video:
어서 오세요 (eo-seo o-se-yo) = welcome
이거 써 보세요 (i-geo sseo bo-se-yo) = try this one
이것도요 (i-geot-do-yo) = this one too
구경만 할게요 (gu-gyeong-man hal-ge-yo) = I'm just looking
네~ 천천히 보세요 (ne~ cheon-cheon-hi bo-se-yo) = sure, take your time
와… 예쁘다 (wa… ye-ppeu-da) = wow… so pretty
이거요?! (i-geo-yo?!) = this one?!

Tip: 구경 (gu-gyeong) = looking around / sightseeing, 만 (man) = only.

pinnedComment: How do you say "I'm just looking" in your language? 👇
alt: A needle-felt miniature cosmetics shop with pink walls and pastel shelves. Mongle, a coral felt ghost-like mascot, sits on a round counter while five smiling felt shop staff in mint aprons crowd around holding lipsticks, creams and sheet masks. The title reads Shopping in Korea — How do I escape?! The staff call out 어서 오세요 (welcome), 이거 써 보세요 (try this one), 이것도요 (this one too) and push in until Mongle is buried in samples. In a close-up Mongle says 구경만 할게요… (I'm just looking). The staff step back, answer 네~ 천천히 보세요~ (sure, take your time), line up in front of the shelf and bow together, and a price-tag card shows 구경만 할게요 gu-gyeong-man hal-ge-yo = I'm just looking. Then Mongle gazes at a sparkling red lipstick and whispers 와… 예쁘다… (wow… so pretty). All five heads pop up, and they rush back holding the lipstick: 이거요?! (you like this one?!). Mongle sweats as the card returns.
